definitions.full: H8154. shasah [ שָׁסָה ] verb spoil, plunder (rarer synonym of בזז שׁלל, ; with this √ WMM As.u.Eur.131 connects Egyptian name of Beduin plunderers Šôs [ Ša-su, ša-sa ]; connection doubted by Jen ZA x (1895), 331 ); — Qal Perfect 3plural לָ֫מוֺ שָׁ֫סוּ Psa 44:11 they plunder for themselves; Imperfect 3masculine singular וגו אוֺצַר ׳יִשְׁסֶה . Hosea 13:15 elsewhere Participle שֹׁסֶים plunderers Judg 2:14 ; 2Kin 17:20 ; with accusative of location 1Sam 23:1 ; with suffix (as object) שֹׁסֵ֫הוּ 14:48 (probably plural = שֹׁסֵ֫יהוּ , so Sta p. 355 Dr Bu, compare Ges § 91k ), שׁוֺסֵ֫ינוּ Isa 17:14 (|| בֹּזְזֵינוּ ), שֹׁסֵיהֶם Judg 2:16 ; שֹׁסַ֫יִח Jer 30:16 Qr (Kt see שסס ; || בֹּזְזַיִח ); construct ( נַחֲלָתִי שֹׁסֵי 50:11 ; passive וְשָׁסוּי עַםבָּֿזוּז Isa 42:22 .
